init_DDPStrategy: create a DDPStrategy instance with optional model_wrapper dict and sync_bn setting for distributed training
setup_distributed: setup the distributed environment using pytorch launcher and nccl backend via _setup_distributed method
convert_model_syncbn: convert all BatchNorm layers in a model to SyncBatchNorm using convert_model with torch or mmcv
wrap_model_DDP: wrap a PyTorch model with MMDistributedDataParallel using _wrap_model for multi-GPU distributed training
save_checkpoint_master: save a training checkpoint on the master process using save_checkpoint with optimizer and scheduler state
